facts.text: I am looking for book recommendations.
I am interested in learning more about the publishing industry.
I attended a panel discussion on the future of publishing at a literary festival at a university today.
I participated in a thought-provoking discussion at the panel discussion.
I am interested in learning more about the self-publishing aspect mentioned in the panel discussion today.
I want recommendations for popular self-publishing platforms and their features.
I am particularly interested in learning more about Amazon Kindle Direct Publishing (KDP).
I want to learn more about the Kindle Unlimited (KU) program.
I want to learn more about the Kindle Owners' Lending Library (KOLL) program.
I want to understand how KU and KOLL benefit authors.
I am curious about the exclusivity requirement for KU.
I want to know what happens if I want to sell my eBook on other platforms like Apple Books or Barnes & Noble.
I want to know whether I can still use KDP for print books while selling eBooks through other channels.
I want to learn more about the royalty rates for eBooks sold through Amazon's KDP.
I want an explanation of how Amazon KDP eBook royalty rates work.
I want to know whether there are requirements or restrictions to earn the higher royalty rate.
I want to know more about the 90-day exclusivity period for KDP Select.
I want to know what happens if I remove my eBook from KDP Select before the 90-day period ends.
I want to know whether there are penalties or consequences for removing an eBook from KDP Select early.

events.text: Attended a panel discussion on the future of publishing at a literary festival at a university and participated in a thought-provoking discussion.
Discussed KU exclusivity requirement and selling eBooks on other platforms (Apple Books, Barnes & Noble) while using KDP for print books.
Asked about KDP Select 90-day exclusivity period and consequences of removing an eBook before the period ends.
